note.p: Ed Pope notes: 2.10.1804 call on Luntley with E(verina) W(ollstonecraft) and on Thurgar, Smith, Gourbon, Bailey and Metcalfe Lewis Gourbon 15 Primrose St Land Tax 1805, 1807. Lewis Frederick son of James and Mary Gourbon bapt 3.7.1774 St Geo Bloomsbury, married 1796 at Chapel Royal Savoy Ann Dawes. Ann Gourbon of Chiswell St buried Bunhill Fields 12.12.1811 age 39, Lewis Gourbon of Lower George St buried St Luke Chelsea 3.6.1832 age 57. Although Smith and Metcalfe were out, the last four calls were all names of Primrose Street tenants, nos 13, 15, 16 and 19 (numbers not given in Land Tax but the names were in number order, numbers from Sun Fire and Holdens) . Luntley was a surveyor so probably assessing the repairs needed, Thurgar may have had some similar role or perhaps was a tenant too briefly to appear in records.
